# Sahithi Kanjarla

> Sahithi Kanjarla is a Hyderabad-based software engineer (B.Tech CSE, class of 2026) building AI and real-time apps: document AI, RAG over audio and video, computer vision and agentic AI. Open to full-time roles.

## About

Sahithi Kanjarla is a software engineer focused on AI and full-stack development. She started computer science at ICFAI Tech in 2022, moved from IoT experiments into first real projects, and worked as a software development trainee at Codeplayers in 2024. She started the GDG on campus chapter and grew it to 100+ students, was runner-up at the AWS GenAI competition, and placed 3rd at the internal Smart India Hackathon.

In 2026 she worked as an AI intern at NU10 on OCR, and as an intern at Ordnance Factory Medak building dashboards. Currently she is building evidence-driven AI agents that verify their answers.

Outside of code: dance, painting, writing, comics, badminton, teaching and volunteering.

## Selected projects

- GreenSwap: an AI shopping research agent that searches the live web for greener alternatives to everyday products and links each recommendation to supporting evidence. Currently being built. Code: https://github.com/sahithi-kanjarla/GreenSwap
- Doodle Dance: draw a stick figure and it dances with you. Pose tracking runs in the browser through a webcam. Live: https://doodledance.onrender.com Code: https://github.com/sahithi-kanjarla/DoodleDance
- VideoMind: ask questions about a YouTube link, an mp4 or an mp3, in English or an Indian language, and get answers with timestamps (RAG). Code: https://github.com/sahithi-kanjarla/Video_mind
- Together Flow: a productivity app built around shared accountability: weekly priorities, private challenges with friends and shared work sessions. Code: https://github.com/sahithi-kanjarla/together-flow
- VisionVoice AI: an assistive vision system that describes surroundings aloud, using OpenCV, YOLOv8, BLIP and gTTS. Code: https://github.com/sahithi-kanjarla/vision-voice
- NutriSense: an AI nutrition and digital pantry app using the Gemini API, React, PostgreSQL and Supabase. Code: https://github.com/sahithi-kanjarla/nutrisense
- Smart Cane Stick: an Arduino and IoT cane for visually impaired users. Code: https://github.com/sahithi-kanjarla/Smart-Cane-Stick
- Data analytics projects: Retail Sales Performance Dashboard and Employee Performance & Retention Analytics (Power BI), Fashion Store Sales Analysis (Excel), Chemical Equipment Parameter Visualization (Django, React).
